title: fix(plugins)!: team and position recipients reach every holder past 10,000 rows, and a failed holder read refuses instead of answering nobody
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91ow1LxYabwyJZre5CQfiY4)_ Fixes #29503 domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmT6XzrVS2iPpNyXNYL Clause-②: yes (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` now names `team` and the `sys_user_position` read beside the `sys_member` one for a failed holder read; no skill teaches a bound on team or position holders, or what a failed holder read answers. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：共享规则与审批里「团队成员」和「岗位任职」两类收件人/审批人现在分页读完全部人员；读失败不再当作「没人」，而是明确报错；按单个用户的成员判定（团队/角色/岗位）读失败也报错，不再答「不是成员」。 - 为什么改：这两处只读一次、上限 1 万行，读失败还会变空：共享规则会漏授权，按用户重算时一次读故障就会撤销这个人的授权；审批会派给缩水的名单（岗位只剩 sys_member 来源）却看起来完整。 - 风险与回滚：唯一「从有答案变成报错」的情形是这些表的读本身失败（原来答空或 false），属收窄，标题带 `!`；1 万人以下仍是一次读、结果不变；队列（ownership queue）按文件头声明的「读失败该成员规格贡献 0 人」作答：团队规格不变；岗位规格在 `sys_user_position` 读失败时，main 会贡献 `sys_member.role` 过渡源持有人，本 PR 起贡献 0 人，这是声明姿态第一次真正生效，是否改为拒绝留待裁决。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/team-graph.ts`（`readMembershipToCompletion` / `probeMembership`）、`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/ownership-queue-service.ts`（`holderCheck` 保持队列姿态）、`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`（`readHoldersToCompletion`）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/recipient-reads-complete.test.ts`，预期 16/16 通过（含 10,001 人全部在集合内、读失败抛错、缺表仍答无人）。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes The team and position recipient reads still read once at a 10,000-row bound and turned a failed read into nobody. This completes the family #29362 (PR #29497) started with the two `sys_member` reads, through the same shared `keysetWalk` (`@objectstack/types`). No new spelling of the walk: each plugin now has exactly one walk call for all its holder reads. **Site 1, `sys_team_member`.** - Sharing `TeamGraphService.expandUsers` (every `team` sharing recipient, and queue team members) reads to completion through `readMembershipToCompletion`, the generalised #29362 helper in `team-graph.ts`. A failed or incomplete read throws, and nothing is cached for it. - Approvals `expandTeamUsers` (the `team` approver, and `resolveAs: 'team'` expressions) reads through `readHoldersToCompletion`, the generalised #29362 tier read in `approval-service.ts`. This is the same table and defect in the second plugin the card title names. It is folded in under os-dev's bounded in-place exemption (same class, mechanical, same file as the card's site 2, same gate family) and declared in the report. **Site 2, `sys_user_position`.** The assignment limb of sharing `PositionGraphService.expandPositionUsers` and of approvals `expandPositionUsers` reads to completion. A failed read throws instead of answering the `sys_member.role` limb alone. The ADR-0091 D2 validity filter in sharing and the raw read in approvals (commit 04d03c3a0 ruling) are unchanged. **Site 3, the user-scoped holder checks.** - `teamHasMember` and `holdsRole` (`limit: 1`) keep their one-row probe, which no bound truncates, through `probeMembership`. Only the catch changed: absence answers `false`, and anything else throws. - `PositionGraphService.holdsPosition` keeps its 1,000-row page, now as a walk, so an active row behind a long run of lapsed rows still counts. It refuses a failed assignment read instead of falling through to the role check alone. - Measured caller: `recipient-membership-recompute.ts` → `SharingRuleService.reconcileRuleForUser` → `ruleReachesUser`. A thrown probe now rejects before any revoke. The recompute's per-(rule, user) catch logs `recipient membership re-evaluation failed — this user's grants of the rule may not match …`, and the grants stay. On `origin/main` a failed probe answered `false`, and `reconcileRuleForUser` revoked every grant the user held from that rule. Pinned in `recipient-membership-recompute.test.ts`: a user still on the team, or still assigned, through a second row lost every grant on main. **Site 4, queue `expandSpec`: left as declared.** ADR-0142 does not declare "contributes nobody" on a failed read. D2 says "An empty expansion is a fact, not a fault", and D5 says "A read that fails during evaluation leaves the row as it was before evaluation … and logs at `warn`" (for assignment rules). The posture is declared in `ownership-queue-service.ts`'s header: "A failed read of a member table contributes nobody for that specification (fail closed for every admission that reads it)". This PR does not narrow it. - Because sites 1–3 now throw, the queue's own holder check (`specsReachUser`) would have started throwing to the access path and the claim admission. A new `holderCheck` wrapper answers it exactly as `expandSpec` answers the expansion: that specification contributes nobody, logged once. A team specification's answer is therefore unchanged. A position specification's is not: on a `sys_user_position` outage it now contributes nobody, where main contributed that position's `sys_member.role` transition-source holders. That is the posture the queue's header declares for a failed member-table read, reached for the first time. Either failure is now logged where before it was silent. Pinned in `ownership-queue.test.ts`. - The posture question (should a queue sharing recipient refuse too?) is in the report's `open_questions`. **Site 5, the absence check is homed.** `isObjectAbsentError(error, readObject)` is new in `@objectstack/types`, beside `isMissingTableError`. It is the shared missing-table predicate for `readObject`, or the engine's `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` naming `readObject`. This card adds third and fourth callers (`sys_team_member` and `sys_user_position`, in both plugins), so the two `membershipObjectAbsent` copies are deleted. `readObject` is required. No new export from `@objectstack/core`. **What each end caller now sees.** | Caller | Before (failed read) | Now | |---|---|---| | Sharing whole-rule pass (`reconcile`, `revokeRuleGrantsForRetiredRecipients`, per-record pass), `team` / `position` recipient | team: `[]`; position: role holders only → grants revoked | expansion rejects → existing per-rule catch logs, grants stay (**refuses where it answered**) | | Sharing per-user recompute (`sys_team_member` / `sys_user_position` write) | probe `false` → user's grants revoked | probe rejects → per-pair catch logs, grants stay (**refuses where it answered**) | | Approvals `team` / `position` approver | team: "expanded to nobody" + literal; position: tier holders only | literal slot + `could not be expanded — a directory or read-filter lookup failed` with `error` (**refuses where it answered**) | | Approvals escalation (`escalateTo` position), `resolveAs` expressions | assignment-limb failure swallowed | their existing catches take the throw (literal target / no users), as they already do for a `sys_member` failure since #29497 | | Approvals reassign door (`position:NAME` target) | assignment-limb failure swallowed | the throw reaches the caller, as a `sys_member` failure already does since #29497 | | Ownership queue (access, claim, assignment pool, approver slate, queue recipient) | team spec contributes nobody; position spec contributes the `sys_member.role` transition-source holders only | both contribute nobody, logged once. Team: unchanged. Position, on a `sys_user_position` outage: nobody where main gave the transition-source holders (the header's declared posture, reached for the first time) | | Absent object (unregistered, or table never created) | no holders | no holders (unchanged) | **Forced test edits (two files, no assertion changed).** `position-graph.test.ts`'s assignment fixtures and `ownership-queue.test.ts`'s `sys_user_position` / `sys_team_member` fixtures now carry an `id` on each row, as every stored row does. `keysetWalk` reports a row without its key as `truncated`, and the read refuses such a walk. That is the same edit #29497 made to the `sys_member` fixtures. ## Tests - `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/recipient-reads-complete.test.ts` (new). Real engine: ObjectQL + SqlDriver over in-memory SQLite, shipped `SysTeamMember` and `SysMember`, scrambled row ids. `sys_user_position` is declared with the shipped columns, because plugin-security is not a dependency. - Site 1: 10,001 members all in the set, the other team out, 2 reads. Control: 9,999, 1 read. A failed read rejects. A failed read is not cached. Unregistered and dropped table answer `[]`. - Site 2: 10,001 active holders, other-org and lapsed rows out, 2 reads. Control: 9,999 matching rows, 1 read. A failed assignment read rejects even with a role holder present. Unregistered and dropped table answer the role limb. - Site 3: a positive and negative control for all three checks. `teamHasMember`, `holdsRole` and `holdsPosition` each reject on a failed read. Absence of all three objects answers `false`. - `recipient-membership-recompute.test.ts` (3 added). The team and position cases: deleting one of a user's two rows while the holder read fails keeps the user's grants and logs the re-evaluation failure. A healthy-read control. - `ownership-queue.test.ts` (1 added). The queue posture: a failed team or position read leaves `expandMembers` and `isMember` answering nobody for that spec, and logs. Its fixture seeds no `sys_member` transition row for the position, so main answered nobody there too; the pin that seeds one (where main answered the transition-source holders) is follow-up #29604. - `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/team-position-holders-complete.integration.test.ts` (new, same rig): - Team: 10,001 members past the bound, and a team approver routes to all of them. Control: 1 read. A failed read rejects. What the caller sees: the literal plus the failure warning with `error`. Unregistered: the literal, with no failure warning. - Position: 10,001 past the bound. Control: 1 read. A failed assignment read rejects. What the caller sees: the literal, never the tier holder alone. Unregistered and dropped table: the tier limb. - `packages/types/src/object-absence.test.ts` (new). Both absence spellings. An absence attributed to another object, an unattributed `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, and outages are not absence.
Reds on origin/main code (tests committed first, at 5ee0c466; the four source files restored from dbca3ef0) - Sharing: 11 failed / 68 passed across the three files. The shapes: - `expected [ 'usr_000000', …(9998) ] to deeply equal [ …(9999) ]` (team and position past the bound); - `promise resolved "[]" instead of rejecting` (team); - `promise resolved "[ 'usr_role' ]" instead of rejecting` (position, role limb alone); - `promise resolved "false" instead of rejecting` (all three checks); - `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'acct_eu_1:read', 'acct_eu_2:read' ]` (recompute team) and the same for `:edit` (recompute position): the grants were revoked; - the queue pin: `expected false to be true` on the warn only. Its answers (`[]`, `false`) already held on main for this fixture, which has no `sys_member` transition row (see the queue row above). - Approvals: 7 failed / 5 passed. The past-bound pair for each table, `promise resolved "[]" instead of rejecting` (team), `promise resolved "[ 'usr_tier' ]" instead of rejecting` (position), and `expected [ 'usr_tier' ] to deeply equal [ 'position:cfo_office' ]` (caller sees). - Types: `Cannot find module './object-absence.js'`.
Ablations (each leg through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs: anchor 1→0, blob moved, then restored to blob == HEAD with an empty git diff HEAD; plugin suites import source, so no dist leg) - S1, sharing walk `break` after page 1: 2 failed (team and position past the bound). - S2, sharing walk catch → `return null`: 5 failed (team refuses, not-cached, position refuses, `holdsPosition` refuses, recompute position). - S3, sharing probe catch → `return []`: 3 failed (`teamHasMember`, `holdsRole`, recompute team). - Q2, queue `holderCheck` rethrows: 1 failed (queue posture pin: `whether user 'u_d' is a member of team 't_night' could not be read …`). - A1, approvals walk `break` after page 1: 3 failed (team ×2, position past the bound). - A2, approvals catch → `return []`: 4 failed (team and position refuse, both caller-sees pins). - T2, `isObjectAbsentError` drops the object attribution: 2 failed (another object's absence, the unattributed `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`). - First attempts at Q and T were refused by the tool before any run: the anchor and replacement overlapped, so the counts could not move. They were re-anchored as Q2 and T2. No result was read from the refused attempts.
## Acceptance notes - **Clause-② line differs from the claim.** The claim says `no (narrowing)`. This diff adds a public export to `@objectstack/types` (`isObjectAbsentError`), which widens that package's surface, so the PR and changeset say `yes (narrowing)`, as the card delta's PM assumption foresaw. Flagged to the seat. - **Review face:** `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --paths …` names no path face and defers to the changeset's `Clause-②:` line, whose `(narrowing)` arm makes it `--face narrowing` (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`). - **Same-family reads left as they are** (outside this card's five sites, listed in the report for the seat): - the business-unit member reads: sharing `business-unit-graph.ts` and `primary-bu-projection.ts` (`limit: 10000`), and approvals `expandBusinessUnitUsers` (`limit: 10000`, catch → `[]`); - the queue service's own `sys_queue_member` reads (`QUEUE_READ_LIMIT`); - approvals `organizationAdministrators` (`APPROVER_INDEX_CAP`, warns when the cap is hit). - `protocol.ts` (frozen) and `resolve-authz-context.ts` (#29398) are untouched. ## Verification Head: `38c62472` (merges `origin/main` `66ba23e4`; the incoming commits touch none of these packages). Every reading below was taken on that head. The one commit after it, `85872264`, changes only the changeset's prose (the queue position-spec sentence), so no reading was re-taken.
